data.description: A young or older void dragon's bite deals an additional 2d6 points of negative energy damage. A creature reduced to 0 or fewer hit points by this attack must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC %1) or be immediately slain and reduced to ashes (as the disintegrate spell).
